1_declare_with_active_record_and_retire_.persona_cycle: PersonaCycleController._declare_standing_questions passes observe['regime'] alongside observe['cycle_subject']['families'] to PersonaCycleController.standing_questions -> mental_models.standing_questions before the model turn.
1_declare_with_active_record_and_retire_.active_record_required: mental_models.active_regime_classes / regime_standing_question includes key 'market_regime' with anchors ['regime:<regime_class>'] only when an active regime record exists for a strategy in the persona's pool; when none exists, 'market_regime' is omitted so mental_models.declare retires any previously declared 'market_regime' model from the persona bank.

2_deterministic_owner_only_and_private_t.determinism: mental_models.standing_questions normalizes, deduplicates, and sorts pool families and active regime classes so identical pool and regime state always yield byte-identical question declarations.
2_deterministic_owner_only_and_private_t.validation_and_write_boundary: mental_models.normalize_questions rejects 'market_regime' declarations lacking governed regime:<class> anchors ('regime_anchor_required' / 'invalid_regime_anchor'); PUT /api/memory/persona-standing-questions requires a verified persona-svc JWT; PersonaToolBroker exposes only read-only persona_mental_model_read with _NoInput and refuses any write/edit tool or parameter.
2_deterministic_owner_only_and_private_t.read_isolation: Answers live in the persona's own bank and are returned by GET /api/memory/persona-standing-questions and PersonaToolBroker only to the owning persona (or authorized operator read surface for that persona/tenant) after verifying every cited memory in the canonical persona store; other personas, other tenants, and committee/panel sessions are refused or isolated.
